import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int n, t;
    static int[][][][] shortest = new int[15][15][15][15];
    static int[][] cap = new int[400][400];
    static char[][] scien = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reac = new char[20][20];
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int iter = 3;
    static int[] vis = new int[400];

    static int aug(int cnode, int dest, int bneck) {
        if (cnode == dest) return bneck;
        if (vis[cnode] == iter) return 0;
        vis[cnode] = iter;
        for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
            if (cap[cnode][i] > 0) {
                int cret = aug(i, dest, Math.min(bneck, cap[cnode][i]));
                if (cret > 0) {
                    cap[cnode][i] -= cret;
                    cap[i][cnode] += cret;
                    return cret;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int getnode(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y - 1;
    }

    static int[][] reach = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] treach = new int[20][20];

    static void expand(int val) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                treach[i][j] = reach[i][j];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k];
                        int nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= n
                                && treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            reach[ni][nj] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++)
                reach[i][j] = 0;
        reach[sx][sy] = 1;
        reach[ix][iy] = 2;
        int iters = 100;
        while (iters-- > 0) {
            expand(1);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            expand(2);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume the rest of the line

        // Initialize shortest with large values
        for (int a = 0; a < 15; a++)
            for (int b = 0; b < 15; b++)
                for (int c = 0; c < 15; c++)
                    for (int d = 0; d < 15; d++)
                        shortest[a][b][c][d] = INF;

        // Read scien
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                scien[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                shortest[i][j][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        // Read reac
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                reac[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        // Initialize adjacent edges
        int infx = 0, infy = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k];
                    int nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni >= 1 && ni <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n) {
                        if (scien[i][j] != 'Y' && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y')
                            shortest[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Floyd-Warshall
        for (int ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
            for (int kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                for (int ii = 1; ii <= n; ii++) {
                    for (int ij = 1; ij <= n; ij++) {
                        for (int ji = 1; ji <= n; ji++) {
                            for (int jj = 1; jj <= n; jj++) {
                                if (shortest[ii][ij][ki][kj] + shortest[ki][kj][ji][jj] < shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj])
                                    shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj] = shortest[ii][ij][ki][kj] + shortest[ki][kj][ji][jj];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = n * n * 2 + 1;
        int dest = n * n * 2 + 2;

        // Build flow network
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    cap[src][getnode(i, j)] = scien[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reac[i][j])) {
                    cap[n * n + getnode(i, j)][dest] = reac[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j]) && scien[i][j] > '0') {
                    for (int ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
                        for (int kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                            if (reac[ki][kj] > '0' && Character.isDigit(reac[ki][kj])
                                    && shortest[i][j][ki][kj] <= t
                                    && canreach(i, j, ki, kj, infx, infy)) {
                                cap[getnode(i, j)][n * n + getnode(ki, kj)] = 1000;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int mflow = 0, ret;
        int iter = 0; // global iter for DFS
        // We need to initialize vis array
        int[] vis = new int[400];
        while ((ret = aug(src, dest, 1000, vis, iter)) > 0) {
            mflow += ret;
            iter++;
        }
        System.out.println(mflow);
        sc.close();
    }

    // Recursive augment function - need to be static and take vis and iter as parameters
    static int aug(int cnode, int dest, int bneck, int[] vis, int iter) {
        if (cnode == dest) return bneck;
        if (vis[cnode] == iter) return 0;
        vis[cnode] = iter;
        for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
            if (cap[cnode][i] > 0) {
                int cret = aug(i, dest, Math.min(bneck, cap[cnode][i]), vis, iter);
                if (cret > 0) {
                    cap[cnode][i] -= cret;
                    cap[i][cnode] += cret;
                    return cret;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
}
